eval_command: PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m ppo_experiment.evaluate --weights weights/ppo_allocation_train101.zip weights/ppo_allocation_train102.zip --eval-seeds 901 902 903 904 --outdir reports
eval_note: Heldout seeds 901-904 are disjoint from training pool 101-104. OR-Tools and nearest solve the identical Scenario bundle one-shot through optimization.solver.optimize. PPO rolls out sequentially with deterministic actions. Only prep-plus-run totals are comparable: PPO prep includes env construction with all-pairs A-star precompute while baseline route costs sit inside the timed solve, so prep and run buckets must not be compared across contenders. No speed ranking is claimed. Aggregated outcomes show the optimizer ahead on every heldout seed; PPO underperformance is reported as measured and eval seeds were not tuned.
limitations: Tiny synthetic grids only; no responder motion, no new casualties mid-episode, no sensor noise beyond gate fixtures.
Blocked proposals are filtered by the env before commitment; the invalid-attempt count measures filtering, not learned safety.
PPO sees the full feasibility mask and route costs, so there is no partial-observability excuse for its gap to the optimizer.
Bounded compute: 8192 steps per model on CPU; larger budgets or tuned hyperparameters might narrow the gap and were not tried.
Timing compares research-harness totals, not deployment latency; nothing here authorizes operational use.
train_command: PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m ppo_experiment.train --seed {101,102} --train-seeds 101 102 103 104 --timesteps 8192 --outdir weights
